course.title: Biochemistry degree | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: Apply to Life Sciences and select Biochemistry as your major.

reg.title: Regular system of study | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: In the regular system of study, you'll be in school between September and April each year and have your summers free to work, travel, and pursue your interests outside of school.
Finish your degree in four years, instead of five years as in co-op.

uk.title: Life Sciences (includes three majors: Biochemistry, Biology, Psychology) admission requirements for British System (A Levels) high school students | University of Waterloo
quotes: A Level Mathematics, minimum final grade of B. Two of Biology, Chemistry, or Physics (one must be at the A Level), minimum final grade of B. One other academic A Level, minimum final grade of B. GCSE-level English, minimum final grade of B/5.
Passes in at least five unique subjects, three of which must be at the Advanced Level

ib.title: Life Sciences (includes three majors: Biochemistry, Biology, Psychology) admission requirements for IB students | University of Waterloo
quotes: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches HL or SL - minimum 4. HL or SL English A - minimum 4 or HL English B, minimum 5. Two of Biology, Chemistry, or Physics, total 27
IB diploma required with six total IB courses; at least three must be HL.

us.title: Life Sciences (includes three majors: Biochemistry, Biology, Psychology) admission requirements for American (US) system high school students | University of Waterloo
quotes: AP Calculus or Grade 12 Calculus, minimum grade of 75%. Grade 12 English, minimum grade of 75%. Algebra (Pre-Calculus), minimum grade of 75%. Two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics, or Statistics. One other Grade 12 academic or AP course. Minimum overall Grade 12 average: 85% including the required courses.

quotes: Programs other than Engineering February 1, 2027 February 15, 2027

admissions.threshold: Biochemistry (Life Sciences, Faculty of Science): A-Level Maths (B), two of Biology, Chemistry or Physics (B, one at A-Level), one other A-Level (B) and GCSE English (B/5); passes in five subjects, three at A-Level.

Biochemistry (Life Sciences, Faculty of Science): IB Diploma (six courses, at least three HL) with Maths Analysis and Approaches (HL or SL, minimum 4), English A (minimum 4, or HL English B 5) and two of Biology, Chemistry or Physics; total 27, excluding diploma points.

Biochemistry (Life Sciences, Faculty of Science): AP or Grade 12 Calculus, Grade 12 English and Pre-Calculus (each at least 75%), two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Statistics, one other Grade 12 academic or AP course; overall Grade 12 average at least 85%.
